SEPARATE GROUPS ARE REAL. The booklet builds several separate models: the ambulance, two paramedic medical bags (b1-b2, b3-b4), the street scene (b144 onward: base, hydrant, bin, traffic light) and the green bicycle (b163 onward). The bags are carried by minifigures and the street scene and bicycle stand free, so I kept them unconnected. The stretcher group is tied to the ambulance by a contact edge.

The check could not be fully cleared because earlier pieces cannot be removed. The surplus entries below are known mistakes. They should be treated as the same physical piece as the one they duplicate:
(a) b33 (second black 2x3 plate) is the same piece as b10. The list has one lego-3021.
(b) b149 (Trans-Green round plate as trash can lid) is wrong. The lid is the green inverted dish lego-4740, now added as b169. This also clears the Trans-Green round plate conflict with b159.

(c) The extra lego-4477 (five used, four in the list), the extra lego-30414 (b76, three used, two in the list) and the extra lego-6141 pieces are over-counts from guessing at small drawings. Candidates are b26/b54/b55/b81/b82 (the red plates read as 1x10), b76 (probably another piece type), and the round plates b98-b100 and b121/b122/b129-b134, which are more likely 1x1 tiles, headlight lens pieces or other types. I could not tell which from the pages.
